## Short promotional description

LocalDeck is a complete local PHP workspace for Windows 10 and 11. It bundles Apache, PHP 8.2–8.5, MySQL, phpMyAdmin, Mailpit, Redis, Composer, automatic project domains, and local HTTPS in one modern desktop dashboard. Run services only while LocalDeck is active or install them as persistent Windows services—without an account, activation, or separate runtime downloads.

## Suggested release title

`LocalDeck 1.0.0 for Windows`

## Suggested release summary

The first public LocalDeck release delivers a complete offline-first PHP development stack for Windows. Download the EXE installer for a standard setup or the ZIP extract-only package to run LocalDeck from a folder of your choice.
